title_zh: 三階段創傷模式網上研討會（第一階段：建立安全感）
title_en: Webinar: 3-phase trauma model — phase 1 building safety
summary_zh: Beech Trauma Academy 的免費 1 小時網上研討會，講解三階段創傷模式的第一階段，重點是處理創傷前先建立身心安全感，並示範 anchor 等調節技巧。對象為學生及合資格輔導員、心理治療師、社工、心理學家等精神健康專業人員。
summary_en: Beech Trauma Academy offers a free one-hour webinar on phase 1 of the three-phase trauma model: building physical and emotional safety before processing and integrating trauma, including anchoring and regulation skills. It is aimed at students and qualified counsellors, psychotherapists, social workers, psychologists and other trauma professionals.
